response.overview: # Cindai  The story follows the life of a girl named Cindai who struggles with bipolar disorder and lives as a homeless person because she has no relatives to stay with. However, she is always accompanied and cared for by a man named Amir. Amir remains loyal to Cindai and is always by her side in times of hardship and happiness. Cindai Reihana grew up in an orphanage after the death of both her parents. She also has a visual impairment that causes her to often be isolated and bullied by her peers. Cindai grows up to become a rebellious person. Until she meets Iskandar, the only person who treats her well. She begins to fall in love. However, Cindai is disappointed when she discovers that Iskandar is already married. She then becomes determined to separate Iskandar and Yasmin so that she can have Iskandar's love.
response.title: Cindai
